ValidationRule.description: Freight Port field/lookup should not be left blank when Case types are shipment or Claims.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName,'Freight'), OR ((ISPICKVAL(Type, "Shipment")),(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Claims"))), ISBLANK( Freight_Port__c ),FCR__c=FALSE, OR (NOT ( $Profile.Id = '00e90000001yRSS' ), NOT ($Profile.Id='00e90000001wK8z')) /*Data Administrator and System admin*/)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To allocate this case to the correct terminal the "port" is a required field
